summary: The candidate proves the stated uniform original-law moment bound. The accepted finite-table, scalar geometric-height, and three-site results are applied with valid hypotheses and explicit normalization maps. The binary and three-site mass comparisons, scalar surplus and moment estimates, adaptive minimizer and cutoff selection, reflected-displacement concentration argument, and final case exhaustion are valid. Every branch retains the complete original Z in the sampled masses and depths, and its constants imply the claimed coefficient exp(-2^80). The singleton, zero-tilt, cap, tie, and closed-boundary cases are covered. Small-support counterexample checks of both mass comparisons found no violations.
